notes: The main repository source was not modified. Builds ran in a git-archive source copy with private data and venv symlinks.
Audit runs are fresh evidence for the reviewed revision. Baseline JSON files were already committed and were compared, not regenerated.
HEALTH-S1 and reviewed PUB-S3 use reviewed contracts. HEALTH-S3, EDU-S2, HEALTH-S2, CS-S1 rerun selector. ENERGY-S3 and automatic PUB-S3 replay committed generated contracts.
Scientific-library thread limits were set to one through isolated sitecustomize for later child processes. Timings are wall times under audit load, not performance benchmarks.
Independent model checks reuse the shipped selected contracts. Holdouts were used for audit evaluation only, not selection.
Privacy-probes includes mock scorer/check failure injection, explicitly separated from actual extra-file-probe using real scorer, scanner and redteam.
No released tables, row maps, truth, holdout data or keys are included in these evidence artifacts.
